narr: Low pressure tracking from northern Missouri to southern Lake MI spread rounds of thunderstorms across far southern WI. This eventually led to flash flooding in Rock and Walworth Counties after 4-6 inches of rain had fallen.
ev: Several streets flooded and closed in Clinton.
Numerous streets flooded in and around Delavan. A creek flooded in Delavan. Videos and pictures provided.
lsr: Numerous streets flooded in and around Delavan. Videos and pictures via social media.
